core.policy: latest official Standard or Full Add-on build selected by install mode

effects.policy: latest packages referenced by shipped presets

runtimeCritical.policy: pinned and SHA-256 verified until separately validated
runtimeCritical.reason: DLSS/NR/Bridge binary compatibility is more important than blindly following newest assets

installation.isolation: existing non-SECRET-EMKO plugins folder is renamed and preserved before creating a clean plugins folder
installation.rollback: first-install failures automatically restore the original plugins folder

modes.FullNeural: ReShade Full Add-on Support + SECRET EMKO/RenoDX/DLSS stack; requires explicit multiplayer-risk acknowledgement
modes.VisualOnly: standard ReShade + Secret Emko presets/shaders; no native neural/add-on injection
